# grafana_assistant_watcher_calibration (Resource)

Ensures a Watcher has completed initial calibration without interactive questions. Separate setup state means a calibration failure or timeout cannot taint or replace the Watcher configuration resource. Reapplying resumes an existing attempt or accepts completed calibration, including calibration performed in Assistant. This resource does not enforce generated checks or rerun calibration after UI edits. Changing the monitoring goal or datasource scope replaces the parent Watcher. Removing this resource forgets setup state; it does not delete or pause the Watcher.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "grafana_assistant_watcher" "alerts" {
  name   = "Managed alerts"
  prompt = "Monitor Grafana-managed firing alerts. An empty result is an acceptable baseline."
}

# Setup is separate so a timeout cannot taint or replace the Watcher itself.
resource "grafana_assistant_watcher_calibration" "alerts" {
  watcher_id      = grafana_assistant_watcher.alerts.id
  started         = false
  timeout_seconds = 1200
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `watcher_id` (String) ID of the Watcher to calibrate. Import uses the same ID.

### Optional

- `started` (Boolean) Explicit activation intent. Defaults to false. A false-to-true edit starts monitoring; a true-to-false edit pauses it. External pauses are respected: refresh and unrelated edits never resume monitoring. To resume intentionally, apply false then true.
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) Maximum time to wait for initial calibration. A timeout leaves the Watcher and its attempt intact; reapply to resume observation.

### Read-Only

- `failure_reason` (String) Machine-readable calibration failure reason, when available.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the resource.
- `status` (String) Most recently observed calibration status.
- `summary` (String) Requester-visible failure summary. May be empty when the agent did not produce a closing message.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import grafana_assistant_watcher_calibration.name "{{ id }}"
```
